post.description: Apply an ordered bounded batch. Every mutation is independently atomic and idempotent. Valid progress, note, and bookmark transitions always converge: a causal successor wins and true concurrency uses later durable API admission, never progress percentage or client time. Same-identity upsert, delete, and restore are ordinary admitted transitions; replay returns the original receipt without a second admission. Account-library add, remove, and immediate Undo use the same actor admission order. Removal changes no downloaded bytes or activity; an already-open session remains readable until close and cannot reopen unless a later add or Undo wins. Every server admission carries its canonical revision, actor-scoped cursor, server admission time, and payload for later delta or rebootstrap reconciliation; none of these outcomes claims that a client applied locally. Unrelated conflicts and validation rejections do not roll back accepted siblings.
